newsitem.title: UK: UK's Flintshire considers fund manager review.
newsitem.headline: UK's Flintshire considers fund manager review.

text.p: The Flintshire County Council Clwyd Pension Fund said on Wednesday it was considering a review of fund managers for its 360 million sterling portfolio.

The Clwyd Pension Fund said in an official notice that some of the fund's portfolios may be subject to an investment management tendering exercise as a result of a current review of fund structure and investment management arrangements.
The review, a standard procedure periodically undertaken by pension funds, is expected to be completed by the end of the month.

The present managers of the fund are Barclays Global Investors with a passive UK mandate, Gartmore with an active UK and Europe mandate and Baring Asset Management with a mandate for the rest of the world.
